title: Malibu Rising
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
summary: The four famous Riva siblings throw a huge end-of-summer party at their Malibu house in 1983. As the guest list grows and the night runs out of control, the book goes back through their family's past.
readIf: you like a single-night family drama with a big cast, a sunlit setting and a dramatic finale.
skipIf: you want a close romance, as this centres on siblings and many other voices.

pairings.reason: Same author, same glossy period glamour and tangled loyalties, with music at the core.
Another ensemble story with secrets that build toward one night everyone remembers.
A more serious family drama with a similar ability to move between households and decades.
